versions.description:
Module is in Polish language! Post 7 Days to Die leaderboards for kills, deaths, levels, through Takaro. Season leaderboard uses its own Takaro variables (`leaderboard_season_data_1`, `leaderboard_season_message_id_1`) so it can run next to total/lifetime ranking modules. Delete `leaderboard_season_data_1` after a season wipe to reset only the seasonal playtime/stats. Leaderboards give communities a recurring competition loop with scheduled Discord updates.

Use this module to:
- Track zombie kills, levels, and deaths.
- Update leaderboard data on a schedule.
- Post leaderboard results to Discord.
- Keep players competing between wipes, events, or major server updates.

Good fit for 7 Days to Die servers that want automated leaderboards, Discord community updates, and retention-focused competition.
